name: bld6_pisano_prime_not_dvd_succ_of_not_isSquare_five
statement: (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (hp2 : p ≠ 2) (h : ¬ IsSquare (5 : ZMod p)) : ¬ p3_pisano p ∣ p + 1
closed: ∀ (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (hp2 : p ≠ 2) (h : ¬ IsSquare (5 : ZMod p)), ¬ p3_pisano p ∣ p + 1
informal: Uses Mathlib2.bld5_prime_dvd_fib_succ_of_not_isSquare_five, Mathlib2.lib_pisano_dvd_iff_period and Mathlib2.lib_fib_period_iff: if π(p) ∣ p+1 then (lib_pisano_dvd_iff_period + lib_fib_period_iff) F_(p+2) ≡ 1 mod p. But p ∣ F_(p+1) (bld5 theorem) gives F_(p+2) ≡ F_p, and F_p ≡ 5^((p-1)/2) ≡ -1 mod p (Euler criterion, from 2^(p-1) F_p = ∑ C(p,2j+1) 5^j; or Cassini F_p^2 ≡ 1 plus F_(p-1) ≡ -F_p and p ∤ F_(p-1)·… ), contradiction as p ≠ 2. Complements bld4_pisano_prime_dvd_two_mul_succ_of_not_isSquare_five: the period divides 2(p+1) but not p+1.
type: ∀ (p : ℕ) [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)], p ≠ 2 → ¬IsSquare 5 → ¬Mathlib2.p3_pisano p ∣ p + 1
